tasks.old_behavior: Time.parse accepts two arguments: date (String) and now (Time, defaults to self.now). The parsed timezone from the date string is passed directly to make_time as the zone parameter. If the date string has no timezone or offset, d[:zone] is nil and make_time treats the parsed time as local time. Passing an unknown keyword argument like zone: raises ArgumentError.
tasks.new_behavior: Time.parse accepts an optional keyword argument zone: (defaults to nil). When the parsed date string does not include a time zone or offset (d[:zone] is nil), the zone: value is used as the fallback timezone. If zone: is provided and the date has no timezone, make_time receives the zone: value instead of nil, causing the parsed time to be interpreted in that zone rather than local time. If the date string already contains a timezone or offset, zone: is ignored (d[:zone] takes precedence via the || operator).
tasks.compatibility_reason: The new zone: keyword argument relaxes the input contract: previously, passing zone: to Time.parse would raise ArgumentError (unknown keyword). Now it is accepted and used as a fallback timezone when the parsed date lacks a timezone. This is a backward-compatible additive change because: (1) existing callers without zone: continue to work identically (default nil makes d[:zone] || nil === d[:zone]), (2) existing callers with date strings that include a timezone or offset are unaffected (d[:zone] is truthy and takes precedence), and (3) the zone: argument only affects behavior when explicitly passed and the parsed date has no timezone. This enables easier migration from DateTime.parse (which defaults to UTC) to Time.parse.
tasks.test_recommendation: Verify backward compatibility: (1) existing calls without zone: produce identical results to before the patch, (2) existing calls with date strings that include timezone/offset are unaffected when zone: is also passed, (3) new zone: argument works correctly for dates without timezone, (4) passing zone: nil (explicitly) behaves same as not passing zone: at all.
